summary: MSFT ~$531 (+1.2%). New: Microsoft offered voluntary exit packages to ~60,000 staff (level 70 and below, US/Canada/India/UK, decisions by early December) to reshape teams around AI spending; it was also among 26 companies blocking tokenized versions of their shares on OKX/ICE's venue. Cost-cut is mildly positive for margins but signals restructuring; main event is still earnings after the close on Wed 28 Oct, same day as the Fed.
